The form calls it from `saveNote` when the note is new; edits go to `updateVisitNote` instead (`visit-notes-form.component.tsx:434-437`).
2. **REST handler:** `EncounterResource1_9.save` (openmrs1_9 resource, which is the version in use for current OpenMRS) links the encounter providers and calls `Context.getEncounterService().saveEncounter(delegate)` (`openmrs-module-webservices.rest/.../openmrs1_9/EncounterResource1_9.java:77-86`). The 1.8 resource has the same call at `EncounterResource1_8.java:188-191`, which the 1.9 class extends.

I did not read the rest of the method after line 137, so the end line is approximate.
4. **Data access:** `HibernateEncounterDAO.saveEncounter` calls `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate` on the current Hibernate session (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateEncounterDAO.java:80-82`). The interfaces are `EncounterService.saveEncounter` (`EncounterService.java:87`) and `EncounterDAO.saveEncounter` (`EncounterDAO.java:37`).
